national_news.title: India Holds Bilateral Cultural Talks with Azerbaijan and Tajikistan at SCO Forum
bullets: Union Culture and Tourism Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat held bilateral discussions with delegations from Azerbaijan and Tajikistan on the sidelines of the SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi.
Key heritage links highlighted include the historic Ateshgah Fire Temple near Baku, Azerbaijan, which features Devanagari and Gurmukhi inscriptions.
The discussions also acknowledged the recent inscription of Tajikistan's Sumanak tradition on UNESCO’s Representative List of Intangible Cultural Heritage.

national_news.title: PM Modi Launches Projects Worth ₹34,470 Crore in Bihar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi dedicated and laid foundation stones for multiple development projects worth ₹34,470 crore in Vaishali, Bihar, covering energy, roads, and urban infrastructure.
Dedicated the 19.7 km long 'Nitish Setu' 6-lane bridge over River Ganga, built at ₹4,280 crore connecting Kachchi Dargah (Patna) to Bidupur (Vaishali).
Inaugurated the 660 MW second unit of the Buxar Thermal Power Project, flagged off 100 PM-eBuses, and performed Griha Pravesh for over 26,900 PMAY-Urban beneficiaries.

national_news.title: NCB and US DEA Bust Illicit Drug Network Under Operation Monsoon Thunder
bullets: India's Narcotics Control Bureau (NCB) partnered with the US Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) to execute 'Operation Monsoon Thunder' targeting a transnational illicit drug ring.
The operation dismantled an Indian module illicitly supplying psychotropic and opioid drugs to US consumers via digital platforms like Telegram, WhatsApp, and Google Sheets.
Six individuals were apprehended, around 3,000 illicit parcels were identified, and data of over 59,000 US subjects was shared for enforcement.

national_news.title: 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) Commences in Goa
bullets: The 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) opened at Dr. Shyama Prasad Mukherjee Stadium in Goa under the theme 'Stories Without Borders'.
The 9-day festival features over 150 films from 86 countries, showcasing 52 women filmmakers, 62 debut directors, and special showcases from Russia, Spain, and BRICS nations.
Goa Chief Minister Pramod Sawant highlighted state infrastructure goals under the Goa Film Shooting Act, 2021, and single-window clearance mechanisms.

national_news.title: 57th IFFI Features Special Package of 12 Goan Konkani and Marathi Films
bullets: The 57th International Film Festival of India (IFFI) in Panaji, Goa curated a special Goan film package showcasing 12 films in Konkani and Marathi.
The selected films cover diverse themes including identity, family relationships, local traditions, and social realities of Goa.
Key titles featured in the package include Manguirish J. Bandodkar’s 'Ancessao', Vardhan Vijaykumar Kamat’s 'Umesh', Prasad M. Naik’s 'Shakuntala', and Kishor Arjun’s Marathi film 'Daryaa'.

national_news.title: PM Attends IIT Kharagpur Platinum Jubilee and 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi attended the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of IIT Kharagpur, which was established in 1951 as India's first Indian Institute of Technology.
The PM participated in the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh at Lucknow, an annual national skill convocation platform instituted in the 2021-22 academic session.
A total of 52 national-level All India toppers from ITIs, National Skill Training Institutes (NSTIs), and Institutes for Training of Trainers (IToTs) were felicitated at the ceremony.

national_news.title: Indian Navy Inducts Indigenously Built Diving Support Craft DSC A21
bullets: The Indian Navy received 'DSC A21', an indigenously designed and constructed Diving Support Craft (DSC), at the Naval Dockyard in Mumbai.

The catamaran-hull vessel was constructed by Kolkata-based Titagarh Rail Systems Limited (TRSL), with hydrodynamic testing conducted by Naval Science and Technological Laboratory (NSTL), Visakhapatnam.
Built under Indian Register of Shipping (IRS) regulations, the vessel enhances navy capabilities in underwater inspection, diving support, salvage assistance, and coastal operations.

national_news.title: India's Merchandise Exports Expand Across Global Regions in H1 FY27
bullets: India's merchandise exports recorded broad-based regional growth during April–September 2026-27, led by a 44% growth in exports to Africa ($31.42 billion) and 21% growth to Asia ($103.84 billion).
Within Asia, exports to Singapore doubled by 103% to $11.07 billion, while exports to China grew by 36% to reach $11.39 billion.
Exports to the Americas grew 13% to $66.82 billion (led by the US at $50.80 billion), with major growth driven by engineering goods ($27.47B to Asia), petroleum products, and electronic goods.

national_news.title: Ministry of Mines and FICCI Release Framework for Overseas Critical Mineral Investments
bullets: The Ministry of Mines, in collaboration with FICCI, released a concept paper titled 'Enabling Overseas Investment in Critical Minerals' to secure India's strategic mineral supply chains.

The framework focuses on expanding Khanij Bidesh India Limited's (KABIL) overseas operations, establishing a Country-Priority Mineral Matrix, and encouraging extraction of critical minerals from by-products like red mud.
Aligned with the National Critical Mineral Mission, the initiative aims to bolster domestic processing, streamline auction reforms, and enhance global competitiveness through tech-enabled governance.

national_news.title: India Records Strong Regional Merchandise Export Growth in H1 FY27
bullets: During April-September 2026-27, India's merchandise exports recorded highest growth in Africa (44% to $31.42 billion) followed by Asia (21% to $103.84 billion) and Americas (13% to $66.82 billion).
In Asia, China ($11.39 billion) and Singapore ($11.07 billion) were the largest markets, with exports to Singapore registering a growth of 103%.

Major export categories driving growth included engineering goods ($27.47 billion in Asia), petroleum products ($17.05 billion), and electronic goods, which grew by 91% in Asia to reach $10.54 billion.

national_news.title: PM Narendra Modi Inaugurates First SCO Civilisational Dialogue Forum in New Delhi
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated the 3-day First Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Civilisational Dialogue Forum at Purana Qila in New Delhi.
The forum celebrates the civilisational heritage of the SCO region—marking 25 years of SCO's establishment—under the theme rooted in 'Vasudhaiva Kutumbakam'.
Key exhibitions showcased included 'ASTITVA – The Essence of Our Existence' (exploring Delhi's history from 1200 BCE to 1200 CE) and the 18th-century 'Mahabharat Scroll Pavilion – Anant'.

national_news.title: Government Sanctions 1.75 Lakh Houses Under PMAY-Urban 2.0
bullets: The Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA) sanctioned 1.75 lakh houses under PMAY-U 2.0 during the 11th CSMC meeting chaired by Secretary Satendra Singh, taking total sanctioned units past 24 lakh.
In-principle approvals were granted for 1.27 lakh houses in Andhra Pradesh and over 22,000 houses in Maharashtra.
Launched in September 2024, PMAY-U 2.0 aims to construct or purchase affordable pucca houses for 1 crore eligible EWS, LIG, and MIG urban families.

national_news.title: Sports Minister Mansukh Mandaviya Addresses 16th FICCI TURF-2026 Summit
bullets: Union Sports Minister Dr. Mansukh Mandaviya addressed the 16th FICCI Global Summit on the Business of Sports (TURF-2026) in New Delhi.
The government announced an outlay of nearly ₹2,000 crore for a sports goods manufacturing scheme to establish India as a global manufacturing and innovation hub.
France participated as the partner country for the summit, signing an MoU to enhance bilateral cooperation in sports technology and athlete management.

national_news.title: India Defeats Malaysia 4-1 in Women's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy
bullets: The Indian women's hockey team registered a 4-1 victory over Malaysia in the Women's Asian Hockey Champions Trophy in Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.
Goals for India were scored by Khan Mumtaz, captain Salima Tete, Pooja Sahu, and Lalremsiami at the Barkheda Nathu International Sports Complex.
The six-nation tournament features teams from India, China, Malaysia, Thailand, Japan, and South Korea.

national_news.title: Union Commerce Minister Targets $1 Trillion Exports for FY 2026-27
bullets: Union Minister Piyush Goyal set a target of achieving $1 trillion in exports for Financial Year 2026-27 during the FICCI Annual General Meeting in New Delhi.
India recorded $480 billion in exports during the first six months of the current financial year, backed by expanded global market access of $70 trillion.
India has initiated talks for a Preferential Trade Agreement (PTA) or Free Trade Agreement (FTA) with Egypt while advancing negotiations on the India-EU FTA.

national_news.title: India Attracts $11.3 Billion FPI in Early November, Reaches $569 Billion Exports: CEA
bullets: Chief Economic Adviser Dr. V. Anantha Nageswaran announced that India recorded $11.3 billion in Foreign Portfolio Investment (FPI) inflows in the first 18 days of November, addressing the 65th WFE General Assembly.
India's combined exports of goods and services reached approximately $569 billion from April to October, achieving a growth rate of nearly 17% while maintaining around 7% real GDP growth.

The CEA highlighted that India operationalised trade agreements with the UK, Oman, and New Zealand this year, alongside lifting nearly 500 million people above the $4.20-a-day moderate poverty line in the last decade.

national_news.title: Solid Waste Management Rules 2026 Mandate Four-Way Segregation at Source
bullets: The Solid Waste Management Rules 2026 mandate source segregation of waste into four categories: wet, dry, sanitary, and special care waste.
The regulatory framework introduces enforcement mechanisms including mandatory online registration for bulk waste generators, user fees, spot fines, and environmental compensation.
The rules emphasize scientific waste processing, resource recovery, and remediation of legacy dumpsites, supported by initiatives such as a planned ₹361-crore integrated facility at Achan.

national_news.title: PIB Releases Daily Newsletter 'IFFILOID' for the 57th IFFI in Goa
bullets: Festival Director Ashutosh Gowariker launched the fifth edition of 'IFFILOID', the official daily newsletter for the 57th International Film Festival of India.
Published by the Press Information Bureau (PIB) under the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, the bulletin is issued daily throughout the festival held in Goa from November 20 to 28, 2026.
The publication aligns with the theme 'Stories Without Borders', covering program schedules, screenings, filmmaker interactions, and event highlights.

national_news.title: PM Address at FICCI AGM Highlights Corporate Tax Reforms and Economic Growth
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi addressed the Federation of Indian Chambers of Commerce and Industry (FICCI) Annual General Meeting at Bharat Mandapam in New Delhi.

The address highlighted key tax concessions including the reduction of basic corporate tax from 30% to 22% (under the Taxation Laws Amendment Ordinance, 2019) and personal income tax relief up to Rs 12 lakh.
Reiterated India's position as the world's fastest-growing major economy with projected growth around 7%, urging corporate leaders to boost domestic job creation and wage growth.

national_news.title: India's First Telecom Manufacturing Zone Established in Gwalior
bullets: Letters of Intent were distributed to 25 companies for land allotment in India's first dedicated Telecom Manufacturing Zone in Gwalior, Madhya Pradesh.
The project is a joint venture between the Department of Telecommunications (49% stake) and the Madhya Pradesh government (51% stake), aligning with Make in India and Aatmanirbhar Bharat.
Phase-I covers 170 acres with Rs 3,600 crore investment commitment, while Phase-II will expand the manufacturing ecosystem by an additional 450 acres.

bihar_news.title: CtrlS Datacenters to Invest ₹10,000 Crore in 150 MW AI Facility in Bihar
bullets: CtrlS Datacenters signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Bihar state government to invest ₹10,000 crore to establish a 150 MW hyperscale AI facility.
The proposed AI-ready data center will be located on a 100-acre plot near Patna, aiming for commercial operations by 2029–30.
The project is expected to generate 400 direct jobs, comprising 100 on-site positions and 300 jobs created by hosted customers.

bihar_news.title: PM Modi Launches ₹34,470 Crore Development Projects and 'Nitish Setu' in Bihar
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched and laid the foundation stone for development projects worth ₹34,470 crore in Vaishali district, Bihar.
Inaugurated the 9.76-km-long six-lane cable-stayed bridge named 'Nitish Setu' over the Ganga River, connecting Bidupur in Vaishali to Kachchi Dargah in Patna.
Flagged off 100 PM-eBuses for urban transit and conducted Griha Pravesh ceremonies for over 26,900 beneficiaries under the Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban).

bihar_news.title: Major Infrastructure, Energy, and Highway Projects Launched across Bihar
bullets: Inaugurated Unit 2 (660 MW) of the 1,320-MW Buxar Thermal Power Project, RDSS loss-reduction works worth Rs 1,130 crore, and a floating solar project at Phulwaria Dam in Nawada.

Laid foundation stones for projects worth Rs 14,450 crore, including the four-laning of NH-139W (Sahebganj-Areraj-Bettiah) costing Rs 3,800 crore and power evacuation for the 2,400-MW Pirpainti Super Thermal Power Project (Rs 3,350 crore).
Dedicated the 19.7-km Nitish Setu over the Ganga to relieve traffic pressure on Mahatma Gandhi Setu and JP Setu, reducing commute time between North and South Bihar.

bihar_news.title: Durgapur Tops Digital Innovation at PM SVANidhi Samman Puraskar 2026
bullets: Union Minister of Housing and Urban Affairs Manohar Lal conferred the PM SVANidhi Samman Puraskar 2026 in New Delhi across 52 categories.
Durgapur (West Bengal) ranked first in 'Digital Innovation' among cities with a population under 1 million, while West Bengal secured third place in 'Loan Disbursement'.
Since its launch in June 2020, the PM SVANidhi scheme has enabled 8.1 million street vendors to access over 12.1 million loans totaling around Rs 20,000 crore.

bihar_news.title: Union Minister Manjhi Hails Naming of 19.7-km Nitish Setu Bridge over Ganga
bullets: Union Minister Jitan Ram Manjhi welcomed the naming of the 19.7-km Ganga bridge as 'Nitish Setu' in recognition of former CM Nitish Kumar's service.
Built at an estimated cost of Rs 4,280 crore, the extradosed cable-stayed bridge connects Kachhi Dargah (NH-22) in Patna with Bidupur (NH-322) in Vaishali.
The bridge comprises a 9.7-km main structure over the river and 10 km of approach roads, aimed at enhancing connectivity between North and South Bihar.

bihar_news.title: PM Modi Launches Key Infrastructure and Educational Initiatives in WB, Bihar, and UP
bullets: At IIT Kharagpur in West Bengal, PM Modi attended the 75th Platinum Jubilee celebrations, unveiled a special commemorative coin, and launched a PG medical course.
In Bihar, the PM dedicated the ₹4,280-crore Nitish Setu and inaugurated development projects valued at ₹34,470 crore covering roads, energy, urban infrastructure, and healthcare.
In Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh, the PM participated in the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh, felicitating 52 national-level toppers from ITIs, NSTIs, and IToTs.

bihar_news.title: Prime Minister Conducts Multi-State Development Tour Across WB, Bihar, and UP
bullets: Prime Minister Narendra Modi launched developmental initiatives across West Bengal, Bihar, and Uttar Pradesh, focusing on higher education, state infrastructure, and skill development.
Participated in the Platinum Jubilee celebrations of India's first IIT, IIT Kharagpur (established 1951 in West Bengal), interacting with 75 students and unveiling a special commemorative coin.
Felicitated 52 national-level skill toppers from ITIs, NSTIs, and IToTs during the 5th Kaushal Deekshant Samaroh held at Lucknow, Uttar Pradesh.

bihar_news.title: Drip Capital Partners with Bihar Government for Rs 5,000 Crore MSME Trade Finance
bullets: Drip Capital signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with the Department of Industries, Government of Bihar, to facilitate up to Rs 5,000 crore in collateral-free trade finance over five years.
The working capital trade finance will support MSME exporters with fast disbursal within 24 to 48 hours, enabling small units without prior banking history to access credit.

Initial trade marketplaces will be launched in Darbhanga and Madhubani for makhana, Madhubani textiles, and handicrafts, partnering with JEEViKA and the Bihar Khadi Board to link over 100 producer groups and FPOs.

bihar_news.title: Adani Energy Solutions Wins Transmission Project for Pirpainti Power Plant in Bihar
bullets: Adani Energy Solutions Limited (AESL) won a transmission project via Tariff Based Competitive Bidding (TBCB) to evacuate power from the upcoming 2,400 MW (3x800 MW) Pirpainti Ultra Super Critical Thermal Power Plant in Bihar.
The project will be executed through a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV), Vikramshila Power Transmission Ltd., with delivery targeted by the fourth quarter of 2028.
It involves constructing 4 Gas Insulated Substations (GIS) at Jhanjharpur, Bethauli, and Begusarai, adding 881 circuit kilometres (ckm) of transmission lines and 3,160 MVA of transformation capacity.

bihar_news.title: Bihar Cabinet Approves Scholarship Hikes for OBC/EBC and New Social Media Rules
bullets: Under the Mukhyamantri Pichchda Varg Evam Atyant Pichchda Varg Pre-Matric Chhatravritti Yojana, annual scholarship rates were revised to ₹1,200 (Classes 1–4), ₹2,400 (Classes 5–6), and ₹3,600 (Classes 7–10), with ₹1,751 crore sanctioned.
Approved the Bihar Government Servant Conduct (Amendment) Rules, 2026, making prior permission mandatory for government employees to create personal social media accounts.
The new rules prohibit public servants from posting workplace videos, sharing official policy opinions, live-streaming office communications, or using official credentials for personal profiles.
